meta.description:
A low, herb-scented witch's cottage gathers around a generous ground-floor kitchen, with stores and a cramped stair tucked behind it. Above, a candlelit attic study occupies the
    eaves, with a small moonwatching alcove.

layout.description:
A low, herb-scented witch's cottage gathers around a generous ground-floor kitchen, with stores and a cramped stair tucked behind it. Above, a candlelit attic study occupies the
    eaves, with a small moonwatching alcove.

rooms.name: The Herbal Kitchen
rooms.style: The cottage's working kitchen, crowded with a stone hearth, hanging herb bundles, copper pots, and rounded preparation tables. Use warm plaster walls, worn flagstones, and earthy superquadric vessels.

rooms.name: The Broom Passage
rooms.style: A long, narrow service passage lined with leaning brooms, hooks, bundled roots, and uneven timber shelves. Make it shadowy and practical, with dark wood and muted mossy surfaces.

rooms.name: The Root Pantry
rooms.style: A cool pantry of squat jars, root baskets, drying racks, and bulbous storage crocks. Use pale clay walls, packed earth flooring, and dusty vegetable colors.

rooms.name: The Cauldron Hearth Nook
rooms.style: A compact sitting and brewing nook centered on a heavy black cauldron, low stools, and stacks of spellwood. Furnish it with soot-dark superquadric forms and ember-colored accents.
